statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-16240 (PostgreSQL pg_basebackup can use backup manifest content as a format string) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-16240/ lists 16.16 as the fixed release for major version 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, include it. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/885dfee080743fd1ff70bdbb693475795a23922f, pg_basebackup: Fix use of externally-controlled format string, on the REL_16_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-16240 and in the REL_16_16 release tag, not in REL_16_15. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch is the upgrade to upstream 16.16 and lists CVE-2026-16240 under its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. We downloaded every package built from the postgresql16 source in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, on x86_64 and aarch64, each checked against its index checksum: builds 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0. pg_basebackup ships in the postgresql16-client package, and in every build it and the postgres server binary report the PostgreSQL release of the package version, on both architectures, so 16.16-r0 reports 16.16 and the earlier builds report earlier 16.x releases. The earlier builds (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) are built from earlier upstream releases and lack the fix, so they are affected; 16.16-r0 is the first published build that carries it.

CVE-2026-16240 (PostgreSQL pg_basebackup can use backup manifest content as a format string) affects PostgreSQL 18 before 18.7 and is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 18.7: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-16240/ lists 18.7 as the fixed release for major version 18, and the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list it. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/af250ef26280d49ef301c9c64b0d4740180c8821 on the REL_18_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-16240, which is in the REL_18_7 release tag and not in REL_18_6; it changes only src/bin/pg_basebackup/pg_basebackup.c, so that backup manifest content is no longer passed as a format string. Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, lists CVE-2026-16240 under its 18.7-r0 secfixes entry. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built with Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD from the upstream PostgreSQL source release of the same version. As of 2026-11-27 the DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository publishes builds of source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0, for x86_64 and aarch64, and we checked every one of them on both architectures, with package checksums verified against the repository index. The affected program, /usr/libexec/postgresql18/pg_basebackup, ships in the postgresql18-client package of every one of those builds on both architectures. In each build the version strings of the postgres server binary and of the client programs (psql, pg_dump, pg_dumpall, pg_restore, pg_basebackup and pg_config) report the PostgreSQL release that matches the package version (18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4, 18.6 and 18.7 respectively). The fix adds no message text that marks it in the binaries, so the boundary rests on the release each build reports. 18.7-r0 is the first published build carrying the fix. The earlier published builds (18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0) are built from PostgreSQL releases before 18.7 and are affected.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-16240, use of backup manifest content as a format string in pg_basebackup, which lets an already compromised server disclose pg_basebackup memory, in 17.12; earlier 17 releases are affected (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-16240/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-16240). Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.12-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6625-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-16240. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0. pg_basebackup is built from the same source and release as the server.
